correctness.rationale: From the fourteen actual package facet-orbit representatives and two explicit 15-point A5 permutations, an independently written verifier generated exactly 60 group elements, all fourteen expected orbit sizes summing to 490 facets, and the exact face vector (15,105,455,1365,3003,4515,4230,2205,490). Every 5-set is a 4-face; exactly 490 of 5005 6-sets are missing and they match all 490 facet complements. A separate GF(2) bitset boundary computation yields rank ∂4=1001 on 3003 4-chains and rank ∂5=2001, hence dim H4=1. All 490 missing 6-set boundaries ∂Δ5 were checked outside im ∂5, while a nonzero 4-cycle on at most 5 vertices is impossible and on exactly 6 vertices must be the entire ∂Δ5. Thus these are all minimum-support homologically essential 4-cycles. Independent exhaustive block incidence calculation gives 196 carriers/vertex, 70 per unordered pair, and λ triple spectrum 4:5, 13:30, 16:60, 19:150, 22:60, 25:60, 28:10, 31:80. Its five λ=4 triples {1,6,8},{2,4,9},{3,7,11},{5,10,15},{12,13,14} are pairwise disjoint, partition all 15 vertices and form one A5 orbit. A finite exact calculation proves only this frozen labeled complex, not all HP² triangulations.

value.rationale: PASS. The complete set of minimal vertex-supported nonzero middle mod-two cycles of a canonical exceptional eight-manifold is a mathematically natural finite invariant. Its 3-point incidence spectrum and recovered invariant five-block partition are far more informative than the known f-vector, complementarity and 2-design pair counts, and could aid isomorphism, symmetry and coding-theoretic investigations.

limitations: Only one labeled A5-symmetric 15-vertex complex and F2 H4; no integral/geometric systoles or universal classification of 15-vertex HP²-like manifolds.
